description: This file contains test functions for utility functions related to string operations such as differential calculation and set operations, using the Go testing framework and testify assertions.

methods.name: TestDistinctValues
methods.description: Tests the DistinctValues function for correct differential computation between two string slices.

methods.name: TestDistinctValuesEmpty
methods.description: Tests DistinctValues with empty slices to ensure it returns an empty result.

methods.name: TestDistinctValuesDuplicates
methods.description: Tests DistinctValues with duplicate entries in inputs.

methods.name: TestSetSubtract
methods.description: Tests SetSubtract function for correct subtraction of one set from another.

methods.name: TestSetUnion
methods.description: Tests SetUnion function for correct union of two string slices.

methods.name: TestFilterNoUnicodeWithUnicode
methods.description: Ensures FilterNoUnicode correctly filters out unicode characters from strings.

methods.name: TestFilterNoUnicodeWithNoUnicode
methods.description: Ensures FilterNoUnicode leaves strings without unicode characters unchanged.
